# Templates

This directory contains copy/paste starting points for documents and workflows.

## File templates

- `prd-template.md`
- `issue-template.md`
- `gitignore-template.md`
- `sprint-structure.md`
- `sprint-32-plan.md`

## What does not belong here

Project scaffolds with nested directories, workflows, or `.github/` content belong in `docs/examples/` or a dedicated scaffold location.
